errors.text_span: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of occurrences related to the word “an” in a corpus of text. The chart contains three slices, each representing a different category of occurrence.
errors.evidence: The figure consists of two pie charts, not one. The description incorrectly states there is only one pie chart with three slices.

errors.text_span: A large yellow slice, labeled “‘an’字只隐不可见 81.66%”, occupies the majority of the chart, representing approximately 82% of the total.
errors.evidence: The yellow slice represents '单音形容词 + 单音名词' (69.39%), not 'an'字只隐不可见'. The 81.66% slice is orange and belongs to the sub-pie chart.

errors.text_span: A blue slice, labeled “双音形容词+单音名词 229例, 69.39%”, represents approximately 30% of the chart.
errors.evidence: The blue slice is correctly identified as '双音形容词+单音名词', but the label in the description incorrectly states 229例, 69.39%, which belongs to the yellow slice. The blue slice should be 101例, 30.61%.

errors.text_span: Finally, a smaller green slice, labeled “‘an’字只隐不可见 18.34%”, represents approximately 18% of the chart.
errors.evidence: The green slice represents '的'字只隐不显 (18.34%) in the sub-pie chart, not 'an'字只隐不可见. The description mislabels the category.
The description does not state the purpose of the chart: to show the compositional characteristics of the 'an' structure.
The description does not mention the sub-pie chart or its purpose of further subdividing the '单音形容词 + 单音名词' structure.
